symbols.name: number of roles
symbols.meaning: The number of roles in the network, so the data is divided into W streams of volume V/W.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the number of data values a call moves, $W$ the number of roles in the network, $s$ the number of smaller calls the network makes, and $m$ the factor by which the parameter grows.

symbols.name: smaller call count
symbols.meaning: The number of smaller calls the network makes, which counts the calls at parameter f made by one call.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the number of data values a call moves, $W$ the number of roles in the network, $s$ the number of smaller calls the network makes, and $m$ the factor by which the parameter grows.

symbols.name: parameter growth factor
symbols.meaning: The factor by which the parameter grows from one level to the next.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the number of data values a call moves, $W$ the number of roles in the network, $s$ the number of smaller calls the network makes, and $m$ the factor by which the parameter grows.

symbols.name: smaller-call parameter
symbols.meaning: The parameter of a smaller call.
symbols.quote: Here $f$ is the parameter of a smaller call.

symbols.name: number of levels
symbols.meaning: The number of recursion levels, so that the top call has parameter m^k.
symbols.quote: Let $k$ be the number of levels, so the top call has parameter $m^k$ and the bottom calls have parameter $1$; base calls at parameter $1$ cost time linear in their volume.

symbols.name: level index
symbols.meaning: The index of a recursion level, counting levels from the top.
symbols.quote: Here $j$ is the level index, counting levels from the top.

symbols.name: saving exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of the power saving, log base m of s/W, so that s/W equals m^theta.
symbols.quote: Let $\theta = \log_m(s/W)$ be the exponent of the saving, so $s/W = m^\theta$ and level $j$ costs $V m^{\theta j}$.

relations.quote: Recursive power saving is built from a [Linear network with restored auxiliary values](linear-network-exchange.md), a fixed network that exchanges two banks of values and restores every auxiliary value.
For the field-digit parameter $u$ of its bound $O(Vu^\tau)$, the recursion bounds the cost of the [Fast address interchange](address-interchange.md), with $\tau=\theta$.

The same recursion is applied to the [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) on $d$ chunks, with parameter $d$, the number of chunks, and exponent $\lambda'=\theta$, which matches $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$.
